notes.title: DevilishGames and Making Enemies present Scholar Adventure: Mystery of Silence
notes.notes: [p]Developed by [b]Making Enemies[/b] (Ayose Trujillo) and published by the veteran studio [b]DevilishGames[/b], [i]Scholar Adventure: Mystery of Silence[/i] is a classic-style [b]point & click[/b] adventure that will transport players to a mysterious abbey where nothing is what it seems.[/p][p][/p][p]In this first installment of the [i]Scholar Adventure[/i] saga, players will play as [b]William[/b], a young writer searching for inspiration for his first novel. His journey takes him to a remote abbey whose monks have taken a vow of silence. What begins as a simple literary quest soon turns into a chilling enigma: within its walls lies a secret that should never have been uncovered.[/p][p][/p][p]Developed with [b]PowerQuest[/b]—the tool also used to create recent hits such as [i]The Drifter[/i]—and inspired by the graphic adventures of the 1990s, [i]Mystery of Silence[/i] combines [b]dark, detailed pixel art[/b] with a deep narrative and touches of black humor. Players will explore atmospheric environments, solve [b]environmental puzzles[/b], and use the objects they find along the way to uncover the abbey’s hidden secrets.[/p][p][/p][p]The experience will have an approximate duration of [b]two hours[/b] and is designed as a [b]tribute to the classics of the genre[/b], focusing on [b]exploration[/b], [b]puzzle-solving[/b], and [b]narrative immersion[/b]. A [b]demo version[/b] of the game will be available during the [b]Steam Next Fest in October[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3929410/Scholar_Adventure_Mystery_of_Silence/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Bambas! arrives on Steam and Consoles this Friday
notes.notes:
[p]Lace up your sneakers. DevilishGames is stepping up with Bambas!, a quirky new walking simulator launching this Friday on Steam, PlayStation 5, Xbox, and Nintendo Switch.[/p][p]Remember when you were a kid, and the streets were your playground, where every curb, puddle, or sidewalk turned into an epic quest? Bambas! brings back that magic with a sandbox experience that takes you on a nostalgic stroll, thanks to its innovative control system.[/p][p]Explore a lively Mediterranean coastal town brimming with personality and detail, where creativity is king and exploration is your passport to fun. Take control of each sneaker independently using the gamepad's sticks and triggers, just like moving your own feet. But walking straight won’t cut it: you’ll have to dodge crosswalks, kick cans, balance on curbs, and pull off impossible jumps to overcome hundreds of challenges and unlock a wardrobe full of customizable sneakers.[/p][p]Bambas! is more than just a game, it’s a tribute to urban culture, to worn-out soles from endless wandering, and to the stories waiting around every corner. With its non-linear narrative and environmental storytelling, you’ll discover hidden places and meet characters who’ll lead you down unexpected paths.[/p][p]Slip on your sneakers and get ready to make your mark, because every step counts here.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3274390/Bambas/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Onirike will come to Steam and consoles on June 29th
notes.notes:
Two years after its official announcement, and after being exhibited at international festivals such as NRW Green Virtual Indie Expo, Steam Game Festival or Valencia Indie Summit, the new independent project by DevilishGames announces its release date on PC and consoles.

Onirike will be released on 29 June (A few days later on PlayStation 4) and will be priced at €14.99 in its digital version for Steam, PlayStation 4, Xbox One, and Nintendo Switch.

With an aesthetic that reminds stop-motion films and a fairy tale narrative, Onirike is a 3d video game that mixes platforms, exploration, stealth, and puzzles in an intricate open world full of dreams and nightmares.

Wishlist now!!! >>> https://store.steampowered.com/app/1229270/Onirike/

notes.title: Onirike’s new trailer and Steam page
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26692354/4fe2514391f517b6bd41042b49c944c142c2329b.jpg[/img]

Add to your wishlist on Steam!!!! >>>> https://store.steampowered.com/app/1229270/Onirike/

Dreams are fed by our own desires. They dwell within us since we are born and so we call them until they come true. But, have you ever wondered what happens to dreams that never come true?

Onirike is an original adventure, puzzles, and 3d platformer video game that plays in an intricate open world, designed with a non-linear narrative, and presented with a peculiar graphics and sound aesthetic.

During the game, the user will take control of Prieto, a strange being that unknowns his nature, but who has the rare ability to become invisible. Exploration, stealth and gypsophila plants grow will be key to unveil the story of Prieto and the orb in which he lives.

Main features:
[list]
[*] Explore Onirike’s intricate open world.
[*] Discover its charming non-linear story.
[*] Be amazed by its peculiar graphics and sound aesthetics.
[*] Gain new abilities for Prieto.
[*] Grow gypsophila strategically.
[*] Avoid dreams devourers using invisibility.
[/list]

Onirike is a project granted by Red.es and European Regional Development Fund (ERDF) through the Red.es Program of Impulse to Videogame Sector. The grants are co-financed by the ERDF in the Multiregional Operational Program of Spain 2014-2020 (POPE).

notes.title: King Lucas on Nintendo Switch
notes.notes:
Three years after it was launched on PC, where it has sold more than 40.000 units, DevilishGames’ King Lucas is preparing its landing on Nintendo Switch, thanks to the port made by Hidden Trap and Noobology.

King Lucas is a platformer game with touches of adventure and metroidvania. Inspired by the 8 and 16 bits classics, the player will have to fulfil the missions ordered by King Lucas and the curious inhabitants of Sausan’s castle. Initially, the castle is made up of a few rooms, but throughout the game, it grows to a size of over 1000 rooms.

Features:
[list]
[*] Get money and buy upgrades such us compasses and crystal balls, more weapons such us magical sticks and swords, or harder shields to protect yourself from the giant spiders, the armored rats, the piranhas and the many other haunted beings in the castle.

[*] Talk and interact with a lot of NPCs who will play different funny and unexpected roles through your quest (yes, there’s some hidden story underneath the arcade!).

[*] Enjoy classic mechanics with a renewed graphic aspect that will delight the 80s and 90s adventure platform game lovers.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26692354/c8a7f36c87b9969600c37b268cf82cd5d9675c8c.jpg[/img]

notes.title: New update available
notes.notes:
Thanks everybody for buying King Lucas! 

We're receiving tons of feedback from you and we're working on it to make it even better. In next weeks we'll publish several updates to fix some bugs and add new features and content. The first of these updates has come, including:

- Possibility to respawn in multiplayer mode.

- Some fine tuning in the prices of items and weapons.

- Changes in the hardness and performance of some enemies to make them more challenging.

- Gamepad sensitivity adjusted to avoid deadzones.

- Small bugs fixed in single and multiplayer modes.
